scientific_question: Can the corrected nine-PT reconstructed-field family and all supplied nine-camera calibrations form a finite, exact-adjoint, nondegenerate controlled straight-ray inverse benchmark for the C-route warm-start study?
role: post-open private controlled proxy development; not real experimental pairing

inputs.model_calibration_pairing: complete 9 x 13 cross-product; no pair is labelled as the true experimental match
inputs.field_preprocessing: subtract global mean, then divide by global RMS

operator.observation: two transverse gradient line integrals per valid ray
operator.quadrature: order-2 Gauss-Legendre inside every trilinear cell interval
operator.adjoint: exact Euclidean transpose of the stored COO weights

metrics: per model, calibration and camera-count p50/p90/worst tails

independent_recomputation.camera_ray_construction: direct from raw R,t and frozen target-plane coordinates
independent_recomputation.quadrature: independent order-3 Gauss-Legendre inside every node-plane interval
independent_recomputation.solvers: standalone normalized BP, CGLS and geometry-Jacobi PCGLS

decision_order: Any operator, observation, accounting or independent-recomputation failure makes v156 inconclusive and blocks prediction.
A valid classical envelope only authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU warm-start predictor on this private synthetic cross-product.
No result may infer a true PT-to-calibration match from filenames, metrics or visual appearance.
Measured two-dimensional BOS observations remain mandatory for a real-BOST claim.
